{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(data))
print("Unique patients:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient counts:")
duplicate_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = duplicate_counts[duplicate_counts > 1]
print(duplicates)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for assay_batch unit issue
print("\nAssay batch counts:")
print(data['assay_batch'].value_counts())

# Check arm and severity distribution
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(data['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(data['severity'].value_counts())

# Check for control arm with moderate severity
control_moderate = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print("\nControl arm, moderate severity patients:", len(control_moderate))

# Check if any of these have -999 in baseline
print("Number with -999 in baseline:", (control_moderate['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
